packageRules.description: Kotlin and the serialization plugin must move together: the plugin is built against a specific compiler version, and a mismatched pair fails the build rather than reporting a version problem.
Ktor server modules share one version.
Exposed core/jdbc/json go in as a single version.
kotlinx libraries move independently of each other but are noisy one PR at a time.
Major updates get their own PR: they cannot be merged without looking.
